blocks.text: Ankita ne soft-blue sleeveless kurti pehni thi. Stole chair pe pada tha. Usne usse uthaya nahi. Monday shaam mirror ke saamne jo faisla kiya tha, woh ab body pe tha.
Doorbell baji.
Chotu andar aaya. Delivery-app verification ke liye supporting certificate, receipt aur unki readable photo upload karni thi.
“Didi, portal pe supporting photo upload karni hai.”
“Table pe rakh do. Main pages seedhe karti hoon.”

Chotu sofa pe baith gaya, bilkul coffee table ke opposite. Phone haath mein; camera documents ki taraf tha. Ankita table ke doosre kinare khadi thi aur certificate aur receipt table pe failane lagi. Light se glare aa raha tha. Pages fold mein the. Pehli framing mein receipt ka ek kona light reflect kar raha tha, isliye Ankita ne pages phir se flat karne shuru kiye.
Woh jhuki.
Is baar accident nahi tha.

Usse pata tha Chotu bilkul saamne baitha hai. Usse pata tha sleeveless kurti ka neckline aage ko khulega. Usse pata tha agar woh itni der jhuki rahi toh woh dekhega. Saturday ko Rey ke rocket ke paas jo ek second ka freeze hua tha, ab woh usse test karna chahti thi — jaan-bujhkar.

“Didi… angle…”
Aage kuch nahi bola. Aankhen wahi thin.

Ankita pages ko adjust karti rahi. Pehli photo mein receipt ka text clear nahi aaya tha; Chotu ne camera ka angle dobara set kiya aur Ankita ne folded kona dabakar seedha kiya.

Phir usne dheere se nazar uthayi.

Document ke upar se.  
Seedha Chotu ki taraf.
Confirmation ke liye.
Unki aankhen mili.

Chotu ki aankhen wide thin. Usme shock tha, hunger tha, aur ek ajeeb si guilt bhi. Usne turant nazar nahi hatayi. Ankita bhi nahi. Ek full moment. Uske lips thode se kaamp rahe the. Ankita ke andar excitement aur sharam ek saath daude — pehli baar kisi aur mard ki itni clear, raw reaction uske apne breasts pe.
Chotu ne zabardasti nazar phone pe laayi. Screen blur dikh rahi thi usse.
“Photo… ho gayi didi.”
Awaaz uski control mein nahi thi.
Ankita seedhi hui. Neckline wapas settle hua. Cream skin fabric ke peeche chup gaya. Usne stole ab bhi nahi uthaya.
“Upload kar do.”
Verification complete hua. Chotu utha. Uske kadam tez the. Door pe jaake usne sirf itna kaha:

Bahut short. Door band ho gaya.
Ankita wahi khadi rahi.
Table pe documents ab bhi khule the. Usne unhe nahi chhua.

Uske legs ke beech halki si, clear tightness thi.  
Garmi spine se nahi, **neeche beech mein** fail rahi thi.  
Usne jaan-bujhkar usse dikhaya tha.

Aur jab confirmation ke liye nazar uthayi thi, toh uski aankhon mein jo kuch tha — woh uske body ne poora feel kar liya tha.

Woh dheere se sofa pe baith gayi.

Ankita ne aankhen kholi. Soft-blue kurti ab bhi uspe thi. Stole ab bhi chair pe tha.

Jo usne abhi kiya tha, uska weight uske legs ke beech baitha hua tha.
